mapper.select: select l.id, l.start_date, l.end_date, t.name as leaveTypeName from attendance_leave l join attendance_leave_type t on t.id = l.leave_type_id where l.is_deleted = 0 and t.is_deleted = 0 and l.status = 2 and l.applicant_id = #{userId} and l.start_date <= #{endDate} and l.end_date >= #{beginDate} order by l.id asc
